end.parentNote: Asha practised making 10 using fingers and repeated the partner-finding method. Gauri correctly found the missing partner for several numbers and noticed that 10 can be made in many ways. At first, Gauri mixed up the idea and thought only 5+5 was possible; this was corrected during the lesson by checking finger pairs. At home, practise by showing a number of fingers and asking, “How many more make 10?”
